name: OHare 2006
description: United ramp employees and flight crews reported a disc-like object hovering near Concourse C at Chicago O'Hare; FAA noted airline-filed unusual incident. Popular culture tie-in: punch-hole cloud debates.

witnesses.desc: O'Hare ramp — craft below cloud base
Concourse C vicinity — metallic disc, hovering
Terminal area — rapid vertical departure / hole-punch cloud lore

notes: Witness times anchored ~4:15–4:55 PM CST Nov 7 2006 (UTC +6); exact minute splits vary by retelling.
Ideal instrument playground: KORD METAR, Chicagoland Nexrad, dense ADS-B era (still imperfect vs 2025).
